title: Drop Four Dash
hook: Take turns dropping discs, but every third turn the board tilts.
prompt: connect four but the board tilts every few turns, pixel art, play with a friend online

rules.summary: Four in a row wins. Every third turn the board tilts one way and loose discs slide.

characters.describe: a pixel hand in your colour

build.what: the board tilts every few turns
build.how: a module in src/tilt.js that slides discs after every third move and animates the tilt through the board's own cells
build.accept: after the third turn the discs slide to one side

build.how: an engine override of the flat camera rig that adds a short shake on the tilt event

overrides.why: a short camera shake when the board tilts
